compute_prdc: compute precision, recall, density, and coverage metrics for real vs fake feature manifolds
compute_pairwise_distance: compute euclidean pairwise distances between two sets of feature vectors
compute_nearest_neighbour_distances: compute distances to the kth nearest neighbours for a set of input features
get_kth_value: get the kth smallest value along a specified axis of a numpy array
refactor_compute_prdc: refactor compute_prdc to support custom distance metrics beyond euclidean
